1.0.label = The Sniper
1.1.label = Intro 1.1.alert.modal = A skilled sniper can have a large impact on the outcome of a battle. The sniper's scoped rifle is deadly and accurate at long range. The ideal position of a sniper is in cover in an elevated position with a rifleman nearby who can help acquire targets and protect from close range enemy attacks.
1.2.label = Sniper Role in a Team 1.2.alert.modal = Snipers work best as long-range support in an attack. They should clear the way for friendly infantry to advance, and then provide overwatch support for the duration of the mission.
1.3.label = Firing Position 1.3.alert = Move forward to the firing line. #waypoint label: "Firing Line" #waypoint: -314046.56,3603720.08,101.73
1.4.label = Using the Rifle Scope 1.4.alert = It is never advantageous to fire the sniper rifle from the hip. Aim with the rifle's scope by pressing {fpgunsight}.
1.5.label = Aimed Firing 1.5.alert = While aiming with the scope, fire at a target by pressing {fpfire}.
1.6.label = Go Prone 1.6.alert = Going prone allows the sniper to aim their rifle more steadily and remain less visible to the enemy. [NL][NL]Press {fpprone} to go prone now.
1.7.label = Gunsight Range 1.7.alert.modal = Adjusting sight range is particularly important to snipers. The default range setting is 200 meters. 1.7.alert1.modal = Take a moment practice estimating the distances of the targets downrange and adjust your sight range accordingly. [NL][NL]Use {gunsightrangeinc} and {gunsightrangedec} to increase and decrease your range setting. 1.7.complete.modal = Good job. This completes your basic sniper training.
content.brief: Learn how to be an effective sniper
